trails.name: Moniteau Wilderness Trail
trails.uses: multi-use: equestrian; bicycles allowed on open and service roads, closed on multi-use trails during firearms deer season and spring turkey shooting hours

notes: mdc.mo.gov could not be fetched (DNS failure in session), so facts come from search summaries of MDC pages. The 10-mile length is from an older MDC trail guide per the search summary, not the current page. Third-party 2016 Missouri Trailblazing page calls it a 12-mile loop under the name Rudolph Bennitt Trail; not used as official. Acreage per MDC: 3,575. Equestrian camping only in designated campsites near parking lots. Our app trail Moniteau Trail 4.0 does not match the official name Moniteau Wilderness Trail; may be the same trail under a different name, unverified.
